'''Pandaroot''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Pandaroo]] at 6 bronze stars and into [[Pandarrior]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Life is simple: eat honey-filled bamboo, sleep, and sunbathe. When the mood strikes, Pandaroot acts cute and basks in the screams of front-row fans."

Pandaroot is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, white and green panda that holds a bamboo shoot with honey oozing from the top.

Pandaroot's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces green with cyan.

== Evolution Trial ==
Pandaroot's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Pandarrior]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Pandaroot to increase stats 3 times.
* Shoot 20,000 pinballs.

== Trivia ==
* Pandaroots decription used to say: "Pandaroot's got a weed-whacking license, but it mostly just uses it to chop down bamboo." 
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its description said: "Generally, experienced trainers feed Pandaroot honey syrup, a drink made from honey and berries. But if you want to be lazy, you can just buy a bag of instant candy. Every Tatari eats those anyway."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its description said: "With a jar of honey in tow, Pandaroot spends the day in sunshine and sweetness, napping once the jar is empty."
